name: Moscadello di Montalcino

known.via: English Wikipedia "Moscadello di Montalcino (wine)" (redirects to "Moscadello di Montalcino")

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A sweet white wine from the Tuscan village of Montalcino, made mainly from Moscato Bianco. It comes still, including a late-harvest (vendemmia tardiva) version, or semi-sparkling.
